recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-10676 unless the work group separately reopens the module taxonomy question.
issue_request: FHIR-10676 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I change request from DSTU2 asking whether REST, Messaging, and Documents should move from Foundation toward Workflow because they are exchange architecture paradigms and were awkwardly listed as common use cases. The final resolution was to add quick links under Foundation for Messaging, Documents, and Services following REST API + Search; a later Jira comment recorded that this was already done as a new Exchange section.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-10676-tagged source commit was found. The apparent application is untagged commit c397bd0b1f4c760dd227af300eaa8044b9e968a3, which created source/exchange-module.html, removed the old Foundation exchange common-use-case section, removed REST API + Search from the Foundation module box, and added a dedicated Exchange box with REST API + Search, Documents, Messaging, Services, and Databases.
additional_context: The current build-scoped pages preserve that organization. source/modules.html includes the module diagram, source/modules-fragment.html lists Exchange beside the other Level 2 infrastructure modules with the requested links, source/foundation-module.html points to Exchange for recognized exchange methods, and source/workflow.html explains how REST, Messaging, Services, and Documents relate to workflow execution. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting instruction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because moving the exchange paradigms into Workflow now would contradict the later/current module taxonomy, while the current Exchange module satisfies the accepted Jira application.
